ORDER DENYING PETITION FOR REHEARING
On November 24, 1998, the Wisconsin Employment Relations Commission issued an
Order Affirming and Modifying Examiner’s Findings of Fact, Modifying Examiner’s
Conclusions of Law, and Affirming in part and Reversing in part Examiner’s Order. This
decision was served on the parties by placement in the mail that same date.
No. 29093-C

Page 2
Dec. No. 29093-C
On December 15, 1998, the Commission received a petition for rehearing from
Respondent Council 24, WSEU Local 1942, AFSCME, AFL-CIO.
Section 227.49, Stats. requires that a petition for rehearing be received by the
Commission within 20 days of the date a final order is served on the parties. ROCK COUNTY,
DEC. NO. 24794-A (WERC, 10/87). In this case, the 20-day period expired December 14, 1998.
Therefore, the petition for rehearing is untimely.
NOW, THEREFORE, it is
ORDERED
The petition for rehearing is denied.
Given under our hands and seal at the City of Madison, Wisconsin this 18th day of December, 1998.
WISCONSIN EMPLOYMENT RELATIONS COMMISSION
